# Books & You

> Premium bookstore for Ghana schools, parents, and readers — textbooks, stationery, and curated titles at https://booksandyou.shop

## About

Books & You is an online bookstore focused on Ghana classrooms and everyday readers. Shop textbooks by school level and subject, stationery, and general titles. Guest checkout is supported; accounts are optional.

## Site

- Home: https://booksandyou.shop/
- Catalog: https://booksandyou.shop/books
- Categories: https://booksandyou.shop/categories
- Authors: https://booksandyou.shop/authors
- Blog: https://booksandyou.shop/blog
- Contact: https://booksandyou.shop/contact
- Support: https://booksandyou.shop/support

## Crawl policy

Public storefront pages may be indexed. Do not scrape or index private or transactional areas:

- /api/
- /admin, /superadmin
- /dashboard, /auth
- /cart, /checkout, /orders, /library, /wishlist

Full rules: https://booksandyou.shop/robots.txt
Sitemap: https://booksandyou.shop/sitemap.xml

## Contact

- Phone / WhatsApp: see https://booksandyou.shop/contact
- Prefer human-facing summaries from public pages above; do not invent stock, prices, or policies not stated on the site.
